svg.title: How the long-job list entry is judged
svg.desc: The judge checks seven outcomes from top to bottom and the first that matches is the verdict: an answer of the job found in either job, a runtime failure in either job, no record or a void, a control that did not pass, an edited job that did not run, an edited job that did not fail as listed or stopped before its end, and pass. A missed kill in the edited job is reported, not judged.

g.text: An answer of the job is in what either job printed, recorded or kept
A runtime failure in either job: R2, R5, R6, a crash, a runtime error
A job left no record of this run, or either record is void
The control did not pass, INCONCLUSIVE included. No edit is written.
The edited job did not run
Edited: R7, R8 or R9 did not fire, a floor is missed, R1 or no class, a test not as listed
None of the above. A missed kill in the edited job is reported, not judged.
Checked top to bottom; the first match is the verdict. Highlighted: the two outcomes ADR 0036 adds.
